contractors.title: Contractors
contractors.description: I&C partners and labour crews: who they are, how they deliver, and what OneOhm owes them.
contractors.emptyBody: Add your I&C partners here. Their crews then get work orders and payables automatically.
contractors.crewCount: {count, plural, =0 {No crew yet} one {# crew member} other {# crew members}}
contractors.onTimeAria: {value}% of finished tasks were on time

form.skills: Kinds of work their crews take
form.serviceAreasHint: Separate places with commas, for example Sangli, Miraj, Kupwad.

create.title: Add a contractor
create.description: Profile, bank and payment terms. Add the crew and rate card on the next page.

editSheet.title: Edit contractor
editSheet.activeHint: Archived contractors keep their history but get no new work orders.

issue.title: Issue a work order
issue.description: {name}'s crew lead takes the project's open tasks in their kind of work. Rates come from the rate card.
issue.noCrew: Add a crew member first; work orders go to the crew lead.
issue.dueHint: Leave empty to use the tasks' due dates.

workOrders.title: Work orders
workOrders.emptyBody: Issue one for a project, or assign a task to this contractor's crew from the project.

workOrder.tasksDone: {done} of {total} done. It settles when every task is done.
workOrder.linesHint: Rate lines follow the rate card; lines added by hand stay.
workOrder.noLines: No rate matches these tasks yet. Add rates on the contractor's page.

crew.title: Crew
crew.empty: No crew members yet. Crew members sign in to the field app and see only their own work.
crew.dialogDescription: People with a partner role (for example I&C partner). The lead receives the work orders.
crew.noCandidates: Nobody with a partner role is free. Add the person in Team with the I&C partner role first.

rates.title: Rate card
rates.empty: No rates yet. Work orders price themselves from these.
rates.addDescription: A rate for one project type wins over a rate for every type.

settlement.preview: Payable when all tasks are done
settlement.netHint: After rework, retention, TDS and advances.

line.title: Add a line
line.description: Per-day labour or an extra agreed with the contractor.

rework.title: Record rework
rework.description: What had to be redone, and any amount to deduct from the payout.

advance.title: Pay an advance
advance.description: Creates a contractor payable now; it is deducted when the work order settles.

cancel.title: Cancel this work order
cancel.description: Its tasks are freed. Reassign them to whoever takes the work over.

material.title: Material
material.description: What this contractor’s crews hold, per project.
material.empty: Nothing has been issued to this contractor yet.
material.allAccounted: Everything issued is used or back in the store.
material.outstanding: {count, plural, =1 {# item with them} other {# items with them}}
material.settled: {count, plural, =1 {# more project fully accounted for} other {# more projects fully accounted for}}
